verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents sharing data with other clusters without exposing cluster credentials or sharing compute, which fits zero-copy live sharing on its compute–storage separated architecture. The docs only say 'other clusters', not other accounts or organizations, and give no detail on mechanics or limits. missing for 10: explicit cross-account/cross-organization sharing, documentation of how shares are created, governed and kept live without copying, independent or hands-on corroboration.
